verdicts.tldr: A non-Latin zero or a DIVIDES sign inside a Latin title passes validText and keeps its own titleKey, so 'B၀ards' lists beside the seeded 'Boards'
verdicts.details: validText (validate.gno:125) sets foreign only for unicode.IsLetter runes outside mixesWithLatin, so a digit (Myanmar U+1040, Devanagari U+0966) or a math symbol (U+2223) never trips the Latin-mixing rule, and IsDigit even satisfies alnum. foldRune folds only ASCII '0' to 'o' and '1'/'|' to 'l', returning every other rune unchanged, so titleKey('B၀ards') is 'b၀ards', not 'boards', and upsert's byTitle check misses it. A user browsing the store sees two listings drawn as 'Boards' or 'Gno.land Blog', one of them an impersonator. Fix: fold the decimal-digit zeros and ones of every script (unicode.Nd with digit value 0/1) and the vertical-bar look-alikes (U+2223, U+01C0 already refused, U+05C0, U+FF5C) in foldRune, or refuse a non-ASCII digit or symbol between Latin letters in validText.
verdicts.evidence: Head, scratch worktree at 8ee3be1: gno test . -run TestB10Confusable -v with the finder's file copied in: 'myanmar zero validText=true titleKey("Boards")="boards" titleKey("B၀ards")="b၀ards" reason=""', 'devanagari zero ... titleKey("Gn०.land Blog")="gn०landblog" reason=""', 'divides as l ... titleKey("Gno.∣and Blog")="gno∣andblog" reason=""', --- FAIL. seed.gno:13-14 lists Title "Boards" and "Gno.land Blog", so the originals exist. Base: examples/gno.land/r/gnoland/store does not exist at 47d19f8 (ls: No such file or directory); the realm is new.
verdicts.verify_by: cp tests/b10-lines-reach-catalog-titlekey-confusables_test.gno examples/gno.land/r/gnoland/store/v0/zz_b10_confusables_test.gno; cd examples/gno.land/r/gnoland/store/v0 && gno test . -run TestB10Confusable -v. Expect title_taken for the 'myanmar zero', 'devanagari zero' and 'divides as l' cases; observe reason ""

verdicts.tldr: An all-Lisu or all-Cherokee title drawn as 'ACME' passes validText and gets a key of its own, so it lists beside the Latin 'ACME'
verdicts.details: validText refuses a foreign script only when Latin letters are also present (return alnum && (!latin || !foreign)), so a title written wholly in Lisu (U+A4EE..) or Cherokee capitals passes. foldRune has cases only for Cyrillic and Greek, so titleKey returns the Lisu runes unchanged and the Cherokee ones lowercased to U+AB8A..; neither equals 'acme' and upsert lists the twin. The all-Cyrillic twin the titleKey comment names does collide, so the protection holds for one script of look-alike capitals and not for the two other Unicode scripts made of Latin-shaped capitals. Fix: fold the Lisu and Cherokee letters that draw as Latin capitals in foldRune, or refuse those two scripts in titles outright, since neither has letters a title needs that cannot be drawn otherwise in this directory.
verdicts.evidence: Head, same run: 'all Lisu validText=true titleKey("ACME")="acme" titleKey("ꓮꓚꓟꓰ")="ꓮꓚꓟꓰ" reason=""' and 'all Cherokee validText=true titleKey("ᎪᏟᎷᎬ")="ꭺꮯꮇꭼ" reason=""', after the setup upsert of 'ACME' returned "". Read: foldRune (listing.gno:566-614) has no Lisu or Cherokee case. Base: the realm does not exist at 47d19f8.
verdicts.verify_by: Same test, cases 'all Lisu' and 'all Cherokee'. Expect title_taken; observe reason ""

verdicts.tldr: titleKey lowercases before folding, so Greek capital Nu, Mu, Zeta and Upsilon land on the wrong letter and an all-Greek 'TOKEN' registers beside 'TOKEN'
verdicts.details: titleKey runs foldRune over strings.ToLower(title), and foldRune maps the lowercase forms by their lowercase shape: 'ν' to 'v' and 'υ' to 'u', while their capitals N and Y draw as Latin N and Y; 'μ' and 'ζ' have no case at all, though M and Z draw as Latin M and Z. So 'ΤΟΚΕΝ' keys to 'tokev', 'ΖΟΝΕ' to 'ζove', 'ΜΙΝΤ' to 'μlvt' and 'ΚΕΥ' to 'keu', each distinct from its Latin twin; validText accepts all of them because no Latin letter is present. The BOX control, whose Greek capitals keep their shape when lowercased, collides as intended. Fix: fold the uppercase rune before lowercasing, mapping capital Ν to 'n', Μ to 'm', Ζ to 'z', Υ to 'y' (and Cyrillic Ү/ү to 'y', Һ/һ to 'h'), then lowercase what remains.
verdicts.evidence: Head, scratch worktree: gno test -v -run TestB1Greek . with the finder's file copied in as b1_claims_fold_test.gno: 'TOKEN: Greek twin accepted with a distinct key: "token" vs "tokev"', 'ZONE: ... "zone" vs "ζove"', 'MINT: ... "mlnt" vs "μlvt"', 'KEY: ... "key" vs "keu"', no BOX line; 'a second app took a title drawn as TOKEN: "ΤΟΚΕΝ"', --- FAIL on both tests. Read: listing.gno:554 'for _, r := range strings.ToLower(title)' and foldRune 'case ν: return v', 'case υ: return u'. Base: the realm does not exist at 47d19f8.
verdicts.verify_by: copy tests/b1-claims-greek-capital-fold.gno into examples/gno.land/r/gnoland/store/v0 as b1_claims_fold_test.gno, then run gno test -v -run 'TestB1Greek' . there. Expected: equal keys, and mallory-token refused with title_taken. Observed: the keys differ and mallory-token is listed. The BOX control (every letter folds correctly) passes
